target_customer: Commercial real estate private equity firms and asset managers with large building portfolios
problem: Building data such as leases, loan documents and condition reports is scattered across PDFs and spreadsheets, so capital planning, retrofits and compliance depend on slow, costly consultant work.
business_model: Enterprise B2B SaaS for asset managers
product_category: AI-native commercial real estate operations platform

founders.name: Leia de Guzman
education: Queen's University, environmental science and business
founders.background_notes: YC page: Investments Director across Europe and Asia, seven years, 8B USD deployed.

founders.name: Stephanie Grayson
education: Stanford, MBA and Master's in Sustainable Built Environment
founders.background_notes: YC page: commercial real estate investor who deployed 2B USD.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting structured building data from thousands of messy documents and running multi-step analyses was hard in 2022, before modern LLMs; the company spent a long R&D period after YC.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated building data and portfolio integration with large asset managers create lock-in, but document AI is widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found of an incumbent copying or buying Cambio; the product was in stealth R&D until January 2026.

market_need_then: The YC launch post says capital planning and compliance depend on costly, slow consultant engagements and manual analysis of scattered documents; regulation on building emissions and reporting is increasing, though no 2022 spend figure was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses cambio.ai; the YC slug cambio-2 suggests another Cambio existed in the YC directory.

identity.visual_style: Enterprise SaaS site with client logos
identity.voice_and_tone: Insider claim: built by real estate investors for real estate investors

branding.brand_signature: Built by real estate investors for real estate investors

brand_strength.rationale: Press covers funding rather than the brand; the name is common and shared with other Cambio companies.

outcome_analysis: Cambio went through YC in Summer 2022 and then built in stealth, launching publicly in January 2026 with an 18M USD Series A at a reported 100M USD valuation. Founders with deep institutional real estate backgrounds and large asset manager customers explain the traction claims, which are company reported. It is active and the outcome is unresolved.
notes: The Series A is stated by Bisnow, Crunchbase News and Pulse 2.0 (via search snippets); the Business Wire release returned 403 and was not worked around. Total funding of 22M USD is per Crunchbase News snippet, implying about 4M earlier funding; a Climatebase posting mentions a seed at a 35M valuation, unverified and not recorded as a round. Exact seed date and investors are unknown. No competitor sourced to 2022 was found; the YC launch post names none, and Yardi and VTS results were undated aggregator pages about broader property software. Founder education and employers are from the YC page.
